# Non-functional requirements

Security, privacy, availability, and experience are verifiable platform criteria,
not generic promises.

::: {.need #NFR-001 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="security;encryption" derives-from="STK-001" implemented-by="COMP-001" verified-by="TC-016"}
## Protect credentials in transit and at rest

Credentials and secrets shall use approved encryption during transport and storage.

### Rationale

Protects secrets from interception and exposure in persistent storage.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-002 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="security;availability" derives-from="STK-003" implemented-by="COMP-001" verified-by="TC-014"}
## Keep authentication available

The authentication service shall achieve 99.95% monthly availability.

### Rationale

Unavailable identity blocks work across all consuming systems.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-003 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="privacy;compliance" derives-from="STK-002" implemented-by="COMP-004" verified-by="TC-015" mitigates="RISK-003"}
## Minimize personal data in events

Audit events shall contain only personal data necessary for their purpose.

### Rationale

Minimizes the impact of improper access or leakage from the log repository.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-004 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="performance;authorization" derives-from="STK-004" implemented-by="COMP-002" verified-by="TC-006"}
## Respond to access decisions within 200 ms

The 95th percentile of authorization decisions shall be below 200 ms under nominal load.

### Rationale

Slow decisions degrade experience and encourage insecure workarounds.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-005 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="security;logging" derives-from="STK-005" implemented-by="COMP-004" verified-by="TC-010"}
## Preserve audit integrity

Audit storage shall detect event modification or removal.

### Rationale

A tamperable trail cannot support investigation or evidence compliance.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-006 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="usability;accessibility" derives-from="STK-004" implemented-by="COMP-006" verified-by="TC-013"}
## Provide accessible authentication

Authentication screens shall meet level-AA accessibility criteria.

### Rationale

All users need to complete authentication without depending on a single interaction mode.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-007 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="compliance;retention" derives-from="STK-002" implemented-by="COMP-004" verified-by="TC-011"}
## Retain evidence for the regulatory period

Access evidence shall remain available for the defined retention period.

### Rationale

Meets audit obligations and allows investigation of historical events.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-008 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="resilience;recovery" derives-from="STK-003" implemented-by="COMP-005" verified-by="TC-012" mitigates="RISK-004"}
## Restore the recovery flow within four hours

The service shall restore account recovery within the four-hour objective.

### Rationale

Limits the period in which legitimate users lack a safe recovery path.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-009 type="non-functional-requirement" status="in-review" priority="medium" tags="observability;operations" derives-from="STK-003"}
## Expose operational identity metrics

The product shall publish latency, error, and lockout metrics for operations.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-010 type="non-functional-requirement" status="draft" priority="low" tags="sustainability;operations" derives-from="STK-004"}
## Measure energy consumption per authentication

The product may measure energy consumption per authentication transaction.
:::
